theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_pcl_linear_linepow_growth
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (T : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (z : ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), ‖MvPolynomial.coeff d (T (HeckeEis.linePow n z)).val‖ ≤ K * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ n
theorems.natural_summary: Binomial expansion, linearity, and finite-support coefficient bounds provide one nonnegative constant uniform in z and d.
